payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over factor pairs (h,w) of t, derive candidate zero positions (y,x) from a quadratic formula, then verify count match via manual distance iteration. No recursive backtracking.
payload.rationale: The code exhaustively searches all possible (h,w) dimensions (factors of n) and uses an analytical closed-form to get zero candidates, then validates via counting cells. It is a complete search enumeration with pruning, not recursive branch-and-bound or graph search. The rule's top subtype is backtracking, which loosely fits the iterative candidate check.
